name: ensemble-full-create-trd
description: Create a Technical Requirements Document (TRD) from a Product Requirements Document (PRD). Performs PRD validation, architecture design with alternatives, task breakdown with traceability, optional MCP enhancement, adversarial self-review with a Design Readiness Gate, and structured output with traceability matrices. Team configuration is handled separately by /ensemble:configure-team. All outputs are saved to docs/TRD/.
